CustomField.description: Lookup to the Work Item this Case is a duplicate/repeat-call of. Populated when the agent uses the Duplicate Work Item Detection LWC to link and close a repeat-call Case against an existing open Work Item.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Points to the existing open Work Item this Case is a repeat call for. Set automatically when the agent uses the Related Work Items panel to link and close the Case.
CustomField.label: Work Item
